tree.heading: Commission
tree.text: The term “Commission” means the Cedar Creek and Belle Grove National Historical Park Advisory Commission established by section 410iii–7 of this title.

tree.heading: Map
tree.text: The term “Map” means the map entitled “Boundary Map Cedar Creek and Belle Grove National Historical Park”, numbered CEBE–80,001, and dated September 2002.

tree.heading: Park
tree.text: The term “Park” means the Cedar Creek and Belle Grove National Historical Park established under section 410iii–3 of this title and depicted on the Map.

tree.heading: Secretary
tree.text: The term “Secretary” means the Secretary of the Interior.
